Notice on Day 6 there were NINE after_hours=True logs across the company:\n# e05, e08(x2), e11, e13, e17, e18, e19, e20, e32 -> 10 after_hours logs!\n# Note: framing_rate = 2 (+ maybe 1 from DSL rule -> up to 3 total, 50% decoy -> ~1.0 to 2.0 across 38 others).\nfor framing_non_decoy in [1.0, 1.5]:\n    print(f\"=== framing_non_decoy = {framing_non_decoy} ===\")\n    scores = {}\n    for m in fin:\n        p = (0.95 if c4_var[m] == \"B\" else 0.025) * (0.95 if c5_var[m] == \"P\" else 0.025)\n        for s in fin:\n            for ev in interviews[s]:\n                p *= ((0.24 if ev else 0.76) if s == m else (0.20 if ev else 0.80))\n        for d in range(1, 7):\n            for s in fin:\n                n_cnt = sum(1 for e, ah in raw_logs[d] if e == s and not ah)\n                ah_cnt = sum(1 for e, ah in raw_logs[d] if e == s and ah)\n                if s == m:\n                    p *= pois_pmf(n_cnt, 0.7) * pois_pmf(ah_cnt, 0.3)\n                else:\n                    lam_ah = 0.1 + framing_non_decoy / n_other[d]\n                    p *= pois_pmf(n_cnt, 0.9) * pois_pmf(ah_cnt, lam_ah)\n        scores[m] = p\n    tot = sum(scores.values())\n    for m in sorted(fin, key=lambda x: -scores[x]):\n        print(f\"  {m}: P = {scores[m]/tot:.5f}\")\n'","time":{"start":1794715623034,"end":1794715623107}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dd631e5e001Lclzs0RzHLUQnG","sessionID":"ses_e22ad0377ffe8I2IrSK7UE3fVN","messageID":"msg_1dd62caa5001BZ44sCzs0Kg7nK"}}
